meta.title: Lease Loop
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines

contract.title: Signed contract
contract.rule: The net price locks when you sign, using the price list valid on the signing date. Earlier quotes are estimates. Later catalogue changes do not change your agreed net rent.
contract.error: Signing failed. Refresh to review the current price and availability, then try again.
contract.tax: VAT is added at the rate on each invoice date. A tax change can change your total while your net rent stays locked.

explain.title: Explain my price
explain.buyout: Buyout at the end of the term
explain.totalHint: Down payment plus {months} monthly rents, before VAT. Buying the item at the end is optional and not included.
explain.formula: Monthly rent = financed amount × monthly factor. The factor depends on the amount and the term, and already includes interest. Each amount is rounded once to the nearest cent; half a cent rounds up.
explain.vatChange: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date. It changes to {rate} % on {date}, so later invoices are higher even though your net rent stays the same.
explain.vatSame: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date.

decision.declined.title: We cannot offer you a lease yet
decision.declined.sorry: We are sorry. You are welcome to keep looking around.
decision.manual.title: A person will check your application
decision.manual.text: Some applications are always checked by a person. This is normal and does not mean the answer is no. We will email you at {email} within 2 working days.
decision.changeLease: Change the term or down payment
reason.min_age: You need to be 18 or older on the day the lease starts. You are welcome to come back when you turn 18.
reason.residency: We can only lease to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
reason.affordability: The rent with VAT, {rent} a month, is more than 30 % of your monthly net income. Up to {max} a month would fit: a longer term or a down payment brings the rent down.

invoices.title: Monthly invoices
invoices.policy: Billed monthly in advance: the first invoice is dated and due on the lease start date. Full monthly rent applies even for mid-month starts. Short months use their last day, then return to the original day. Generation issues the complete schedule, including future invoices.
invoices.separate: Down payment and optional buyout are separate and excluded from these rental totals. VAT follows each invoice date.

impact.title: Your impact
impact.saving: About {kg} of CO₂ saved by leasing this item instead of buying it new. This is an estimate.
impact.noSaving: By our estimate, reusing this item saves about as much CO₂ as getting it ready for its next life costs, so the net saving is about zero.
impact.additional: By our estimate, getting this item ready for its next life adds about {kg} of CO₂ more than reusing it saves.
impact.unavailable: We can't estimate the CO₂ impact of this item yet.
impact.leasesSaving: About {kg} of CO₂ saved by leasing instead of buying new. This is an estimate.
impact.leasesAdditional: By our estimate, your leases add about {kg} of CO₂ compared with buying new.
impact.partial: Some of your items have no estimate yet, so the total leaves them out.
impact.method: We start from the CO₂ of making a new item, credit the share of that a used item still carries (from its condition and usage), and subtract the CO₂ of refurbishing it for its next life. The factors are illustrative, not measured.
impact.row.refurbishment: Refurbishing it for its next life
impact.assumption.fictional_factors: The CO₂ factors are illustrative example values, not sourced figures.
impact.assumption.sourced_factors: The CO₂ factors come from published sources.
impact.assumption.not_measured: Nothing was measured for this item. It is a calculation.
impact.assumption.compared_with_new: Leasing this item is compared with buying a new one.
impact.assumption.wear_price_proxy: How much life the item has left is estimated from how its condition and usage lower its price.
impact.assumption.refurbishment_hypothet: The refurbishment is a typical allowance, not a recorded repair.
impact.assumption.first_use_future_circu: This item has not been leased before. The estimate assumes it keeps circulating after this lease.
impact.assumption.first_use_scaled: For a first lease, the reuse credit is scaled down.
impact.assumption.reuse_previous_lives: This item has been leased before, so leasing it again avoids making a new one.
impact.assumption.counter_assumed_lifeti: The usage counter is assumed to cover the item's whole life.
impact.assumption.counter_reset_prior_ad: The usage counter was reset; earlier usage is added back.
impact.assumption.counter_reset_prior_un: The usage counter was reset and earlier usage is unknown.
impact.assumption.term_not_allocated: The lease length does not change the estimate.
impact.assumption.no_travel_credit: No credit is given for trips that might replace a car.
